rules.prepare:
cd "$AELTRA_SOURCE_DIR" bh_autotools_dev_update
cd "$AELTRA_BUILD_DIR/build_unix"
# trick make into using the right nm mkdir .mybin ln -sf "$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX/bin/${AELTRA_HOST_TYPE}-nm" .mybin/nm export PATH="`pwd`/.mybin:$PATH"
../dist/configure \ --prefix="$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX" \ --build="$AELTRA_HOST_TYPE" \ --host="$AELTRA_HOST_TYPE" \ --localstatedir=/var \ --sysconfdir=/etc \ --libexecdir="$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX/lib" \ --enable-cxx \ --enable-compat185 \ --enable-sql \ --enable-stl \ --enable-dbm \ --disable-tcl
rules.install:
cd "$AELTRA_BUILD_DIR/build_unix" make DESTDIR="$AELTRA_INSTALL_DIR" install
cd "$AELTRA_INSTALL_DIR/$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX/bin" for prog in db_*; do newname=`echo $prog | sed 's/db_/db5.3_/g'` mv $prog $newname done mv dbsql db5.3_sql
